clause_text: This Act may be cited as the ``Make Elections Great Again Act''.

label: PROHIBITION
clause_text: to remove from the official list of eligible voters in elections for Federal office in the State registrants who are determined to be ineligible voters by reason of ... the registrant's status as a noncitizen

label: TEXT_FACT
